text:
Jake Guentzel has 10 goals in 17 games, seven in his last ten, and two in the overtime win in Minnesota. With Nikita Kucherov's trade request hanging over Tampa, the Lightning need someone steady, and Guentzel is it: he plays 20:56 a night, and Tampa owns five-on-five play with him on (60% of the expected goals).

Some of the goals will cool. He is shooting 20.8% against a normal range of about 13.5 to 18%, and his team has scored six more goals than expected with him on the ice. But the chances are his: Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him among the forwards who get to the dangerous ice in front of the net, often off passes across the slot.

Our projection lands him around 40 goals. One more note from the season so far: the University of Nebraska Omaha retired his No. 20 this fall, which tells you how far a 77th overall pick has come.
headline: Guentzel keeps finishing on a team in turmoil
